guide.skyresources3.stage1.stage1.title: Stage 1 - The Basics
guide.skyresources3.stage1.stage1.text: Start by choosing an island route, then build toward life infusion, cutting tools, food, and your first renewable resources. Choose a route: {action:1} {action:2} {action:3} {action:4} {action:5}
guide.skyresources3.stage1.sandIsland.te: The sand route starts from cactus and red sand. Preserve your starting materials, gather early alchemy components from cactus, craft a cutting knife, then use life infusion to reach saplings and dirt.
Infusion stones transform blocks by spending player health and durability. The off-hand item, target block, and required health come from infusion recipes, and the process can later be automated with the Life Infuser.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.knife.title: Cutting Knife
guide.skyresources3.stage1.knife.text: Cutting knives break selected blocks into special drops. Cactus, stone, iron, and diamond knives follow the same player-facing role with stronger materials lasting longer.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.snowIsland.te: The snow route starts by gathering snowballs, building a snow golem, and using the Mini Freezer to make heavy snowballs and heavy snow before moving toward dirt and saplings.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.freezer.title: Freezers
guide.skyresources3.stage1.freezer.text: Freezers convert input items into frozen outputs. Open tier recipes with {action:1} and {action:3}, inspect freezer processing with {action:2}, or view the Iron Freezer setup with {action:4}. Mini, Iron, and Light tiers have different speed and slot counts; Iron and Light Freezers are two-block machines with the controller on the bottom.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.heavySnowball: Heavy snowballs and explosive heavy snowballs provide early ranged damage when snow is your main resource path.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.woodIsland.te: The wood route focuses on the Survivalist Fishing Rod. Fish for useful junk, dirt, and saplings until you can progress into the Stage 2 resource machines.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.survFish.text: The Survivalist Fishing Rod is a cheap, durable rod tuned for junk and small useful catches. Dirt and vanilla saplings are the most important early prizes.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.grassIsland.t: Grass island starts closer to Stage 2 because it already has dirt and tree access. Use it when you want to skip much of the basic survival bootstrap.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.magmaIsland.t: Magma island is the difficult start. Use petrified wood carefully, generate cobblestone from Magmafied Stone and Crystal Fluid, then push toward combustion and the Fusion Table.
guide.skyresources3.stage1.magmaStone.te: Magmafied Stone checks adjacent Crystal Fluid and can create cobblestone. Surrounding more sides with Crystal Fluid increases the number of chances per tick.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.stage2.title: Stage 2 - Resource Production
guide.skyresources3.stage2.stage2.text: Stage 2 introduces most resource production loops. Learn the casing machines, heat sources, fusion, crucible, condenser, and early automation before pushing into advanced machines.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.seeds.title: Seeds
guide.skyresources3.stage2.seeds.text: Vanilla seeds and crop starters are produced from grass-based progression. This keeps island starts from depending on naturally generated villages or terrain.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.casing.title: Machine Casings
guide.skyresources3.stage2.casing.text: Machine Casings host Combustion Heaters, Heat Providers, and Condensers. Insert the machine item into a casing, remove it with shift interaction, and choose casing tiers for different heat behavior.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.combustionHea: Combustion Heaters run inside Machine Casings and craft dropped item sets inside a valid multiblock. Higher tiers change fuels, speed, efficiency, and allowed structure blocks.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.waterExtracto: The Water Extractor stores water, extracts it from blocks, places source water, and inserts water into compatible targets. Aqueous machines automate the same water flow later.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.dirtFurnace.t: The Dirt Furnace gives early smelting access before a stable cobblestone generator or normal furnace path is available.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.lavaBlaze.tex: The Blaze Powder Block creates lava when heated from below. This is one early route toward a cobblestone generator before full crucible automation.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.heatSources.t: Heat Sources warm blocks such as Crucibles and Blaze Powder Blocks. Fuel-based Heat Providers become stronger heat sources once casing machines are available.
Heat Providers are casing-installed heat sources. Their tier controls fuel type, efficiency, and heat value, and they can be disabled with redstone.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.rockGrinder.t: Rock Grinders break stone-like blocks into gravel, sand, crushed stone, crushed netherrack, and related processing resources. Rock Crusher automation builds on this behavior.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.metalCreation: Metal production combines {action:1}, {action:2}, {action:3}, and {action:4}. Ore alchemical dust and Crystal Fluid drive the ingot loop; use {action:5} to preview the basic setup.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.crucible.text: The Crucible melts selected items into fluids when heated from below. Crucible Inserters and Fluid Droppers automate the input and output sides.
The Fluid Dropper pulls fluid from adjacent tanks and places a source block below when it has enough fluid, making it useful for automated Crucible output.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.fusionTable.t: The Alchemical Fusion Table crafts alchemical recipes from item inputs and a catalyst. Manual slot contents also act as the automation filter.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.condenser.tex: Condensers install into casings and use an item catalyst, usually ore alchemical dust, to condense the block above and output the result below or into an inventory.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.crucibleInser: The Crucible Inserter automates item insertion into a nearby Crucible through its inventory and item automation access.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.combustionCol: The Combustion Collector catches results from combustion crafting so items do not block repeated crafts in the structure.
Crushed stone and crushed netherrack are cleaned through cauldron or Rock Cleaner processing to produce ore dust paths.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.gemProduction: Dirty gems come from rock grinding and are cleaned into usable gems with water processing. Rock Cleaner automation improves the same process.
guide.skyresources3.stage2.wildlifeAttra: The Wildlife Attractor consumes energy, water, and plant matter time to spawn passive animals above the block, and redstone can disable it.
guide.skyresources3.stage3.stage3.title: Stage 3 - Advanced Automation
guide.skyresources3.stage3.stage3.text: Stage 3 improves earlier production with automation blocks and smarter machines. These tools reduce manual item dropping, cleaning, crushing, and water handling.
The Quick Dropper drops full stacks without a redstone pulse and stops when powered, which makes it useful for controlled machine inputs.
guide.skyresources3.stage3.rockCrusher.t: The Rock Crusher automates rock grinder recipes with FE cost and an improved yield multiplier.
guide.skyresources3.stage3.rockCleaner.t: The Rock Cleaner automates water-cauldron cleaning recipes, consumes water and FE, and improves output yield.
guide.skyresources3.stage3.combustionCon: The Smart Combustion Controller automates combustion crafting from a priority filter and can pass results to a Combustion Collector.
guide.skyresources3.stage3.aqueous.title: Aqueous Machines
guide.skyresources3.stage3.aqueous.text: Aqueous Concentrators and Deconcentrators automate Water Extractor-style insert and extract behavior for water handling setups.
guide.skyresources3.stage4.stage4.title: Stage 4 - Powerful Materials
guide.skyresources3.stage4.stage4.text: Stage 4 focuses on dark matter, light matter, stronger automation, End access, and life-based machines.
guide.skyresources3.stage4.integratedDyn: When Integrated Dynamics is loaded, SkyResources3 adds Life Infusion recipes for Menril Berries and Menril Saplings. Open the infusion recipes with {action:1}. Infuse light blue dye with a red mushroom for berries, then infuse those berries with a birch sapling for the sapling.
guide.skyresources3.stage4.dmWarper.text: The Dark Matter Warper consumes dark matter fuel to transform nearby mobs and optionally affect players or animals according to config.
guide.skyresources3.stage4.end.title: The End
guide.skyresources3.stage4.end.text: The End Portal Core uses a multiblock structure, Ender Eye inventory, and a redstone pulse to teleport players to the End. Open the core recipe with {action:1}, preview the setup with {action:2}, then continue to the improved portal with {action:3}.
guide.skyresources3.stage4.end2.title: The End - Improved
guide.skyresources3.stage4.end2.text: The improved End Portal Core structure adds Silverfish Disruptors, Light Matter Blocks, End Rods, and Purpur Pillars to remove Ender Eye consumption and silverfish harassment.
guide.skyresources3.stage4.healthGem.tex: The Health Gem stores infused health, increases maximum health over time, and provides stored health for Life Infuser automation.
guide.skyresources3.stage4.lifeInfuser.t: The Life Infuser automates {action:1} with a multiblock, {action:2}, an off-hand item, and a target block below the core. Open the core recipe with {action:3} or preview the structure with {action:4}.
The Life Injector damages entities standing on it and stores that health in a Health Gem for later infusion work.
